newsitem.title: USA: Hutchinson Tech stake cut by Vinik group.
newsitem.headline: Hutchinson Tech stake cut by Vinik group.

text.p: A group led by former Magellan Fund manager Jeffery Vinik said Thursday it cut its stake in Hutchinson Technology Inc to 271,600 common shares or 4.95 percent from 6.7 percent previously held.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the sale of 93,500 common shares between January 30 and February 6 at prices ranging from $98.2467 to $114.8281 per share.
Hutchinson is a supplier of suspension assemblies for rigid disk drives. It is based in Hutchinson, Minn.
